arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: David Frederick argued the Eighth Circuit correctly allowed removal.
He stated Philip Morris follows detailed Federal Trade Commission rules.
Justice Roberts questioned if companies can use different testing methods.
He asked if the FTC would allow lower tar figures in ads.
